anya: quick note - int8 on Polaris2B dropped ~3% F1 on SQuAD after quant. fp16 81.4 -> int8 78.2.
miguel: reproducible?
anya: yes, 5 seeds. looks position-dependent after ~64 tokens.
li: any tokenizer oddities?
anya: saw aliasing on composed diacritics (e.g., ñ + combining acute).
sam: bench command?
anya: `bench/run_eval --model polaris2b --quant int8 --eval squad --trials 5`
francesca: bench-bot started job 5001
bench-bot: job 5001 running - fp16 vs int8
anya: quick experiment: reversed rotary proj order at load (k,q) and int8 improved to 79.6
li: Qwen tooling historically expects k-first; Gemma mixed.
miguel: sounds like two compounding issues: proj order + vocab normalizer mismatch.
li: propose loader shim to reorder projections at load-time + add token-normalizer test for composed chars.
francesca: scheduling shim sweep (fp16 / int8 / int8+shim) - job 5002
bench-bot: job 5002 queued
anya: created issue #1430 with logs and patches. will PR shim and unit test for ñ and combining-acutes.
